job_text:
Backend Developer Intern - Northpeak Systems

About the role
Our platform team builds the APIs that power our mobile apps. As an intern you will help design and ship real endpoints with guidance from the team.

Requirements
- Experience writing REST APIs in Python
- Comfortable working with relational databases like PostgreSQL
- Able to write unit tests for your code
- Experience using Git and pull requests

Nice to have
- Familiarity with Docker
- Exposure to AWS or another cloud provider
- Experience with FastAPI or Flask

Benefits
- Paid internship
- Flexible remote schedule
